N01

COMNAVRESFORCOM NOTICE 5050
From: Commander, Navy Reserve Forces Command
Subj: 2026 HOLIDAY PARTY
Encl: (1) Schedule of Events
1. Purpose. To provide information and assign responsibilities for the Commander, Navy
Reserve Forces Command (COMNAVRESFORCOM), Commander, Navy Reserve Force
(COMNAVRESFOR), and Commander, Naval Air Forces Command (COMNAVAIRESFOR)
holiday party to be held Friday, 11 December 2026. The event will be held from 1800 to 2400 at
the Westin Hotel at 4535 Commerce St, Virginia Beach, VA 23462.
2. Scope and Applicability. This notice applies to all COMNAVRESFORCOM,
COMNAVRESFOR, and COMNAVAIRESFOR personnel and guests.
3. Responsibilities
a. Points of Contact: PSC Vanessa Wells and YN1 Naomi Chaney
b. Official Party: RADM Luke Frost; Mr. Randy Johnson; Mr. Garett Edmonds; CAPT
Joseph Droll; CMDCM Robert Lyons
c. Masters of Ceremony: LCDR Jeremy Thomas and Chief Joseph Jedding
d. Coordinators: PSC Wells; YN1 Chaney; YN1 Lavonne Parsons; LS1 Marketa Roundtree;
YN2 Lidia Wolf
e. Public Affairs Officer: COMNAVRESFORCOM Public Affairs Office
f. Invocation: Chaplain
5. Records Management. Records created as a result of this notice regardless of media and
format, will be managed per Secretary of the Navy Manual 5210.1 of September 2019.
J. M. DROLL
Chief of Staff
